resources.string: Allin1 runs on a server (or your own computer). Enter the address of your Allin1 server below — for example https://allin1.onrender.com — or http://192.168.1.10:8000 if you are running it on your own network.
That does not look like a valid address. Try again.
Allin1 could not load. Check that your server is running and that this device has an internet connection.
This download type is not supported in the app. Open it in your browser instead.
Allin1 needs storage permission to save this file.

Allin1 is a universal media downloader. This app is a native Android shell around your own Allin1 server: the server does the extracting and downloading with yt-dlp + ffmpeg, and finished files are saved to your Downloads folder by Android.
